subject.title: fix(qa): prevent live scenarios from racing config restarts

question: Should the QA Lab owner approve using the three Gateway status hashes as the shared post-restart readiness invariant for live transport scenarios?
rationale: The PR is maintainer-authored and carries the protected `maintainer` label, so normal owner judgment is required even though the proposed invariant is narrowly scoped.

options.title: Approve the shared invariant
options.body: Merge after confirming that persisted, loaded, and applied hash equality is the intended Gateway readiness contract for all affected live transports.

options.title: Keep transport-specific readiness
options.body: Request a narrower transport-owned approach if any live transport has a valid readiness condition that differs from the common Gateway status contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared invariant
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming that persisted, loaded, and applied hash equality is the intended Gateway readiness contract for all affected live transports.

likelyOwner.reason: The author supplied the incident analysis and implemented the shared QA Lab synchronization path.
